description: Better tool configuration UI for Super Agent chat session - integrate ToolSelectionModal into chat page

userStories.title: Add Configure Tools option to BaseToolMenu
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Configure Tools option in the chat menu that opens the full tool selection modal.
acceptanceCriteria: BaseToolMenu imports and renders ToolSelectionModal
New Configure Tools menu item with Wrench icon added to dropdown
Clicking it opens ToolSelectionModal with current agent tools pre-selected
Modal receives initialSelectedTools, initialMcpConfig, initialA2aConfig from AgentContext
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in BaseToolMenu.tsx - imports ToolSelectionModal, adds Wrench icon menu item, wires modal open/close with AgentContext props

userStories.title: Wire modal apply to update AgentContext
userStories.description: As a user, I want my tool selections from the modal to apply to the current chat session immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: onApply callback updates agent.tools in AgentContext
MCP and A2A config changes persist in AgentContext
Subsequent chat messages include the updated tool list
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed onApply to use functional updater setAgent((prev) => ...) to avoid stale closure overwriting MCP/A2A config. MCP/A2A already synced via ToolSelectionModal useEffect. Chat payload already sends agent.tools, agent.mcp, agent.a2a.

userStories.title: Add active tools indicator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see how many tools are currently active so I know my configuration state.
acceptanceCriteria: Badge or count shown on the + button or dropdown header indicating active tool count
Count updates when tools are added/removed via the modal
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added a small rounded badge positioned at top-right of the + button showing agent.tools.length. Only visible when count > 0. Reactively updates since it reads from agent.tools which is updated by both the modal onApply and the web search toggle.

userStories.title: Improve BaseToolMenu layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want the tool menu organized into logical sections for quick toggles vs advanced configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Menu has section headers for Quick Toggles and Advanced sections
Image upload remains at top
Visual separation between sections with dividers or headers
Existing functionality preserved (web search, PII, image upload)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reorganized dropdown into 3 sections: Attachments (ImageUpload at top), Quick Toggles (Web Search, PII options with DropdownMenuLabel header), Advanced (Configure Tools with DropdownMenuLabel header). Sections separated by DropdownMenuSeparator dividers. Removed commented-out Add File code. Added DropdownMenuLabel import.

userStories.title: Verify chat submission includes all tool config
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify that the chat payload includes tools, MCP, and A2A config from AgentContext.
acceptanceCriteria: Review useChat.ts handleSSEUnified to confirm agent context tools are sent
If not already sent, add MCP and A2A config to the submission payload
Stream works correctly with tools configured via the modal
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Verified: Both handleSSEUnified (lines 221-224) and handleSSE (lines 329-332) already send tools, mcp, a2a, and subagents from AgentContext in the payload for non-public agents. The agent object is read from useAgentContext() which is updated by ToolSelectionModal. No code changes needed. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Handle default tools conflict
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to ensure the DEFAULT_AGENT_TOOLS useEffect in BaseToolMenu doesn't conflict with modal selections.
acceptanceCriteria: Default tools are only added on initial mount, not after modal changes
If user removes a default tool via modal, it stays removed
Re-opening the menu doesn't reset tools to defaults
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed all useEffects to use functional updater setAgent((prev) => ...) to prevent stale closures. Mount effect deduplicates with Set and only runs once ([] deps). Added hasCustomizedTools ref set to true on modal apply. WebSearch toggle uses functional updater. BaseToolMenu stays mounted in ChatInput so dropdown open/close doesn't re-trigger mount effect. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: End-to-end browser validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the full flow to work: open chat, configure tools, send a message that uses a configured tool.
acceptanceCriteria: Open chat page, click + menu, click Configure Tools
Modal opens with correct pre-selected tools
Toggle some tools, click Apply, tool count indicator updates
Send a chat message — tools are available to the agent
Verified using agent-browser CLI with screenshots
userStories.notes: Fixed useToolSelection hook to sync initialSelectedTools via useEffect when they change after mount. Browser-verified full flow: login, open + menu (3 sections: Attachments/Quick Toggles/Advanced), Configure Tools opens modal with 4 pre-selected defaults, toggle tools (deselect think_tool, select python_sandbox), Apply updates badge count, send 'What is 2+2?' — math_calculator tool invoked successfully. Screenshots saved to /tmp/e2e-*.png.

userStories.title: Verify workspace is clean and push final changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure all changes are committed and pushed.
acceptanceCriteria: Run git status to check for uncommitted changes
If remaining changes exist, commit and push to branch
All commits visible in GitHub PR
